dashboard.empty: No products yet. Add one on the Products page, or import a price list on the Imports page.
dashboard.priceMoves: Price changes over 20% in the last import
dashboard.noAlerts: All open quotes match the catalog.

product.name: Product
product.searchPlaceholder: Search name, ERP code, MPN, brand…
product.chartNeedsTwo: The chart appears once there are two or more prices.
product.inFingerprintHelp: Identifying attribute: products that match on all of these (plus category and brand) are the same product.
product.aliasesHelp: Products merged into this one. Imports matching them resolve here.
product.mergeHelp: “{{name}}” will be deleted. Its price history, ERP codes and identity move to the product you pick.

settings.provider_inception_hint: Text only: spreadsheets and PDFs with selectable text. Screenshots and scanned pages need another provider.
settings.logoHelp: Printed at the top left of quotes.
settings.bankHelp: Printed on proforma invoices. Leave empty until you have the details.
settings.signatureHelp: Printed next to "Signed by" on proforma invoices.
settings.price_age_warning_days: Warn when a price is older than
settings.pi_payment_termHelp: {trade_term} is replaced by the quote's trade term.
settings.roundingHelp: Unit prices computed from cost × margin are rounded half up to this many decimals.

category.name: Name
category.schemaHelp: Key, Chinese label, English label, type, unit, suggested values, and whether the attribute identifies the product.
category.fingerprintColumnHelp: Switch on = identifying attribute (part of the fingerprint). Changing these does not rewrite existing products until they are next saved or imported.

brand.help: Any alias, in Chinese or English, resolves to the brand. Cells like “江波龙（Airdisk）” are matched on both parts.

noteRule.help: Remarks (备注) in imported price lists are matched against these rules, in this order, to set product fields. The first rule that matches wins for each field.
noteRule.patternHelp: A regular expression, for example 接单前确认|实单前需确认. A quantity rule needs a (number) group.

kindHelp.set: Writes the value into the field when the remark matches.
kindHelp.qty: Reads the number in the first group, ×1000 when the second group is K.
kindHelp.text: Copies the whole remark into the field.

product.merge_self: A product cannot be merged into itself

brand.in_use: This brand is used by products

import.xls_unsupported: Old .xls files are not supported. Open the file in Excel and save it as .xlsx.
import.unsupported_type: This file type is not supported ({{type}})
import.unreadable: The file could not be read
import.too_large: The file is larger than 50 MB
import.no_api_key: Add the API key for the selected AI provider in Settings first
import.not_in_review: This import is not in review
import.no_match: Pick the product to update first
import.commit_failed: {{errors}} rows could not be applied; see the rows marked Failed
import.committed: Revert the import before deleting it
import.not_committed: Only a committed import can be reverted
import.one_spreadsheet: Upload spreadsheets one at a time, without images or PDFs
import.mapping_spreadsheet: Only spreadsheets can be mapped by hand
import.mapping_category: Pick the category of the sheet
import.mapping_name: Pick the column with the product name

customer.code_taken: This client code is already used

quote.locked: Only a draft can change; make a new revision instead
quote.last_section: A quote needs at least one table
quote.bad_order: The order must list every line once
quote.no_product: This line is not linked to a product
quote.category_required: Pick a category to save it to the catalog
quote.name_required: A manual item needs a name
quote.combine_two: Pick at least two lines to combine
quote.combine_one_table: The lines to combine must be in the same table
quote.combine_nested: A combined product can’t be combined again
quote.not_combined: This line is not a combined product

proforma.number_taken: This invoice number is already used

note_rule.bad_pattern: This pattern is not a valid regular expression
note_rule.qty_group: A quantity rule needs a (number) group in its pattern
note_rule.value_required: A “set value” rule needs a value

backup.invalid: This file is not a QuoteDesk backup
backup.import_running: Wait for the running import to finish
backup.no_database: There is nothing to back up yet

imports.dropHere: Drop price lists here, or click to choose
imports.dropHint: One Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file, or screenshots (PNG, JPG) and PDFs. Screenshots dropped together become one import.
imports.pickHelp: Pick the sheets that hold prices. Sheets that look like price tables are pre-selected; hidden sheets are listed but left out. A category hint helps the AI but it can still decide per row.
imports.extractHelp: Rows are read by the AI in batches of 60; nothing changes in the catalog until you commit.
imports.noKey: Add the API key for the selected AI provider in Settings to extract with AI.
imports.chunkError: Rows {{rows}} of {{sheet}} could not be extracted
imports.cancelled: Extraction was cancelled. Choose sheets to start again.
imports.deleteConfirm: Delete this import and its uploaded file?
imports.pickHelpMedia: Pick the screenshots and pages that hold prices. A category hint helps the AI but it can still decide per row.
imports.extractHelpMedia: The AI reads each screenshot or page in one go; nothing changes in the catalog until you commit.
imports.noKeyMapping: No API key for the selected AI provider: add one in Settings, or use “Map columns” to import a sheet by hand.

review.undecided: decide every possible match before committing
review.revertConfirm: Undo this import? Prices go back to what they were before it.
review.revertedNote: This import was reverted; nothing from it remains in the catalog.
review.possibleMatchHelp: This row looks like an existing product but no code matched. Pick the product to update, or create a new one.
review.imagePosition: Row {{n}} of the table, counting from the top

issues.default_fx: No exchange rate in the sheet; the default {{rate}} was used
issues.identity_changed: Matched by code, but the identifying specifications changed
issues.older_price_date: Price date is older than the current price ({{current}})
issues.duplicate_in_import: Same product again at {{row}}; that row wins
issues.erp_variant: Same specifications as “{{product}}” but a different ERP code: kept as a separate product
issues.erp_conflict: Matches the same product as “{{product}}” with a different ERP code: skipped. Fix the specifications or create it by hand

customer.name: Name
customer.marginHelp: Overrides the category and global margin for this customer's quotes.
customer.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Its quotes keep the customer details.

quote.customerHelp: Fills contact, email, trade term and language. You can also leave it empty.
quote.layoutHelp: Offer: NO / Name / Description. Quotation list: specs, model, material and photos. Each table can change it later.
quote.search: Search offer no., customer or code
quote.readOnly: This quote is {{status}}, so it can no longer change. Make a new revision to adjust it.
quote.deleteSectionConfirm: Delete this table and its lines?
quote.noLines: No lines yet: search a product below or add an item by hand.
quote.name: Name
quote.descriptionHelp: One spec per line. Start a line with ! to print it in red.
quote.photosHelp: The quotation list prints the first two.
quote.noPhotos: No photos. Add them on the product page.
quote.costHelp: Optional: the margin applies to it.
quote.saveToCatalog: Also save it to the catalog
quote.categoryNeeded: Pick a category to save it

warnings.product_deleted: The product was deleted from the catalog

quote.combineHelp: The customer sees one row with this name, the parts listed as its description and one price. The parts and their costs stay in your internal version.
quote.splitConfirm: Split this product back into one line per part?
quote.parts: Parts, only in your internal version
quote.noParts: No parts yet. Add products from the catalog or type them by hand.

proforma.pickLines: Pick the lines to invoice (a quote of options usually becomes one build).
proforma.title: Proforma invoice
proforma.issueConfirm: Issue this invoice? It can no longer change afterwards.
proforma.issuedHelp: Issued invoices never change. Make a new revision to correct it.
proforma.focHelp: Free spare units, as a % of the quantity; printed under the description.
proforma.bankHelp: Bank details, seller contact and signature come from

config.intro: Saved builds, such as a laptop made of CPU, screen, RAM, SSD … Insert one in a quote as a single product: the customer sees its name, the parts as its description and one price. Catalog parts always take the current catalog price.
config.empty: No configurations yet. Create one here, or save a combined product from a quote.
config.name: Name
config.costChanged: Catalog prices changed since the last save (was {{was}})
config.costChangedLong: Catalog prices changed since this configuration was last saved: the cost was {{was}}, it is now {{now}}.
config.deleteUsedConfirm: Delete this configuration? The {{count}} quote line(s) that use it keep their copy.
config.marginHelp: Used when the configuration is inserted in a quote, before the customer, category and default margins.
config.noPhotos: No photos yet. Quotation lists print the first two.
config.partsHelp: Each part prints as one line of the description. Catalog parts take the current catalog price. Typed lines with cost 0 add a spec only (keyboard layout, ports, certifications …).
config.notUsed: Not used in any quote yet.
config.saveFromLine: Save as configuration for later quotes

mapping.title: Map the columns of “{{sheet}}”
mapping.help: Import this sheet without the AI: say which row holds the column titles and which column holds what. Every row below the titles becomes a product row in the review, exactly as after an AI extraction.
mapping.fxHelp: Empty: the default rate from Settings.
mapping.noColumns: Nothing under this row. Check the title row number.
mapping.name: Product name
mapping.nameHelp: Pick several columns to join them, for example type + model.
mapping.attributesHelp: * identifies the product: map them so the same product is recognised next time.

backup.help: QuoteDesk copies its database at every start. Make a copy yourself before big changes. A full backup also holds the photos, uploaded price lists and settings: use it to move to another computer.
backup.keysNote: API keys are never in a backup: enter them again in Settings → General on a new computer.
backup.name: File
backup.restoreHelp: Products, prices, customers, quotes and invoices go back to this copy. The current data is saved first, so you can undo this.
backup.restoreFullHelp: Products, quotes, photos, uploaded files and settings go back to this copy. The current database is saved first, so you can undo this.
backup.restored: Restored. The data from before is in {{safety}}.
backup.retentionHelp: Older automatic and manual database copies are deleted beyond this number.
